title: Coast Guard rescues 2 from capsized sailboat, 65 miles east of New Jersey
description: A Coast Guard HC-130 Hercules aircrew from Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, supports an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Atlantic City, New Jersey, as they hoist two survivors from a capsized vessel about 65 miles east of Atlantic City, May 29, 2019. When their sailboat capsized, the mariners used their properly-registered emergency position indicating radio beacon to alert the Coast Guard to their distress. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy, Air Station Elizabeth City)
